notes.title: We are coming to Gamescom 2025!
notes.content: [p]We are astonished to announce that we'll [url="https://indiearenabooth.de/gamescom2025/games/show/19000"]indeed [/url]be at gamescom this August: of course as part of one and only Indie Arena Booth, but also as a part of Bavaria delegation![/p][p][/p][p]We've never been at any showcase of this caliber, so we are equally dreaded and excited. If you are also coming, please say hi and play our first public demo![/p][p][/p][p]And if you play it good enough, we'll even give you a Fish.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45007669/26c53b68943e6bac7c12562f27523edfad12291c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]His name is Gados, and it's a chainsaw fish. Our one and only beloved mascot![/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, till next time![/p][p]- Nozomu Games team[/p]

notes.title: Burn your cards and do forbidden rituals in the deck-builder Burn With Me
notes.content:
Burn With Me is a narrative deck-builder like no other, where permanently burning your cards is one of the main game mechanics.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/burn-your-cards-and-do-forbidden-rituals-in-the-deck-builder-burn-with-me/

notes.title: Welcome back!
notes.content: [p]Hello, students![/p][p][/p][p]After we've made the successful Ludum Dare prototype of Burn With Me, we knew that full release was just a matter of time. Unfortunately, when core team is just a couple of people, it's hard to make several games at once. So, we decided to first finish Robot Detour. It was fun![/p][p]After that — small break, and in January we started working on resurrecting Burn With Me. 5 months later we are here: with new crazy look, new crazy ideas for the game, and surprisingly even a story! With characters![/p][p]We'll see where this adventure will lead us, and we don't want to spoil too much yet, but this is a wild ride, and we are enjoyng every second working on this game.[/p][p][/p][p]Please look forward to it![/p][p][/p][p]- Nozomu Games team[/p]
